//: Headers only — no build, routing or framework settings, so whatever the
Vercel dashboard is configured with keeps working.
The HTML shell must revalidate on every visit. index.html is what carries
the ?v= cache-busters that version app.js and config.js, so a cached shell
pins a visitor to the build it was cached from: the site can deploy any
number of times and that phone goes on loading last week's JavaScript and
showing last week's figures. must-revalidate costs one conditional request
data/rewards.json is the published totals, rewritten on a schedule. It has
the same problem for the same reason, so it revalidates too. The versioned
assets underneath do not need this — that is the point of the ?v=.
